study: Does the bar that just closed mark the minutes whose next 3 minutes run. Six pre-declared rows, each reported on both halves. No %R.
registered_at: 2026-10-18, before any return of these rows was computed.
origin: Operator 2026-10-18: find, with a test, how to pick the minute a run starts. The %R counts did not mark it. About 5% of those minutes rose more than 30 bp over the next 3 minutes, in every combination. This test asks whether the bar that just finished is different from a random minute.
what_a_session_is: Every bet is intraday. The bar is read at its close. The return is the next 3 minutes of that same session. Half A, sessions on or before 2026-07-23, is where the two cutoffs are taken. Half B, sessions after 2026-07-23, is the other column. The split is which sessions. It is not a daily hold.
outcome: A minute runs when the SIP return from the open of minute m+1 to the close of minute m+3 is more than 30 bp. The share of minutes that run is the number to beat. Each row's base share is every scored minute in that half that the row could have been drawn from: every minute for the ret1 and range rows, and only minutes with a close 3 minutes earlier for the ret3 rows. The same holds for the drop share (a fall of more than 30 bp).

rows.ret1_hi: The bar that just closed, close divided by open minus 1, at or above the 80th percentile of half A.
rows.ret1_lo: That same 1-minute return at or below the 20th percentile of half A.
rows.ret3_hi: Close now divided by the close 3 minutes ago, minus 1, at or above the 80th percentile of half A. Minutes with no close 3 minutes ago are left out of this row and out of its cutoff.
rows.ret3_lo: That same 3-minute return at or below the 20th percentile of half A.
rows.range_hi: The bar's high minus low, divided by its close, at or above the 80th percentile of half A.
rows.range_lo: That same range at or below the 20th percentile of half A.

cutoffs: Each cutoff is the 20th and 80th percentile of that feature on half A minutes only. The return is not an input to the cutoff. Half B does not move the cutoff. A minute is not compared with a percentile computed from later minutes of its own day.
forward: Known at the close of minute m: that bar's open, high, low, and close, and the close 3 minutes earlier. The return starts at the SIP open of m+1. A later bar is not an input. No flat fill of a missing minute.
what_is_printed: For each row and each half: days, minutes, the share that ran (up more than 30 bp), the share that fell more than 30 bp, the share that were up at all, the row's own base run and drop shares and base minutes, the day-clustered gross mean and its t, net10_bp and net3_bp (gross minus 10 bp and minus 3 bp), the day-clustered run gap and its t, and the day-clustered run-gap-minus-drop-gap (day_edge) with its t. A close-entry line for each row and half: the same counts with entry at the close of m+1 and exit at the close of m+3 (E.markout_close), against that row's base on the same minutes. The all-minutes base of each half is printed once. Per-day minutes (min, median, max, days under 1000) are printed with the totals. The trail is not simulated.
description: HIGHER when, on both halves, the row's run share is above its base, the run gap is above the drop gap, the day-clustered run-minus-drop gap has t >= 2, and the close-entry day_edge is above 0. BOUNCE when everything but the close-entry condition holds: the edge sits in the first print of m+1 (bid-ask bounce and print timing) and is not an open. WIDER when the run share is above base on both halves but the run-minus-drop edge is not clear on both: the row only moves more, both ways. LOWER when the run share is below base on both halves. NOT THE SAME when the two halves disagree. THIN when either half has fewer than 30 days, fewer than 1000 minutes, or no share. There is no PASS and no single call. A description does not change config. The size of the gap over the base share is the result. A HIGHER row whose gap is a fraction of a percent is not an open. Bars and returns are SIP and live reads IEX: a HIGHER is SIP-only and needs an IEX-feature replication, under its own prereg, before any use.
left_out: No %R line, gap, hook, or square. Volume pace, a name already up on the day, news, sector, and a volume breakout are already closed and are not in this test.
data: Same warehouse and sample as the path test: 119 sessions 2026-04-28..2026-10-15, 400 names per session seeded sha256(day|prescreen-sample), names with today's IEX, today's SIP, and the previous session's IEX. The parent list is the prior day's liquid names, not today's watchlist. SIP for the bar and for the return. A name is not dropped because of how many bars the finished day has. The run refuses unless n = 119, first = 2026-04-28, last = 2026-10-15, and the median split is 2026-07-23.
window: Minutes 09:31 through 15:56 ET, by the bar's start-of-minute label. The 09:30 bar (complete at 09:31) is not scored, which is conservative. 15:56 is the last minute whose 3-minute return ends on the 15:59 close. Pre-market is not in the warehouse, so 09:31 and 09:32 have no ret3.
no_retuning: The six rows, the 20th and 80th percentiles, the 30 bp run, the 3-minute return, the window, the sample, and the 2026-07-23 split are fixed. A different cutoff or a seventh row is a new prereg.
command: On the mini, after a result-skeptic Mode 1 READY, and only then: scp tools/studies/pr_run.py to /tmp, then REPO=$PWD nice -n 19 .venv/bin/python /tmp/pr_run.py --score. No pytest over SSH. No config edit.
amendment_2026-10-19: Before any score was run (Mode 1 review not finished). The first word compared only the run share with base. A wider bar raises the share that rises 30 bp and the share that falls 30 bp together, so range_hi, ret1 tails, and ret3 tails would read HIGHER on symmetric noise. The run gap must now beat the drop gap at day-clustered t >= 2 on both halves; otherwise WIDER. Rows, cutoffs, window, sample, and split are unchanged.
amendment_2026-10-19b: Result-skeptic Mode 1 NOT READY, before any score, findings fixed: (1) net10 and net3 are now printed per row and half; (2) ret3 rows are scored against a base of minutes with a close 3 minutes earlier; (3) a close-of-m+1 entry line is printed and a HIGHER that is gone there reads BOUNCE; (4) SIP-only and IEX replication stated; (5) window wording corrected for start-labelled bars; (6) per-day minutes printed. Rows, cutoffs, 30 bp, hold, window, sample, and split are unchanged.
